text:
debrief db-021
1) t-h-e a-c-t-o-r t-o-o-k s-t-e-p-s t-o c-u-t o-f-f e-s-s-e-n-t-i-a-l u-t-i-l-i-t-y s-e-r-v-i-c-e-s, l-e-a-v-i-n-g s-h-u-t o-f-f i-n-t-e-r-r-u-p-t i-n-v-o-i-c-e-s, w-h-i-l-e s-k-i-p-p-i-n-g t-h-e r-e-q-u-i-r-e-d u-t-i-l-i-t-y s-t-a-t-u-s n-o-t-i-f-i-c-a-t-i-o-n.
2) t-h-e a-c-t-o-r c-h-a-n-g-e-d l-o-c-k-i-n-g m-e-c-h-a-n-i-s-m-s w-i-t-h-o-u-t c-o-o-r-d-i-n-a-t-i-o-n, l-e-a-v-i-n-g r-e-p-l-a-c-e-d h-a-r-d-w-a-r-e a-n-d o-l-d k-e-y r-e-c-o-r-d-s, w-h-i-l-e s-k-i-p-p-i-n-g t-h-e l-e-g-a-l o-c-c-u-p-a-n-c-y a-u-t-h-o-r-i-z-a-t-i-o-n.
3) t-h-e a-c-t-o-r d-i-s-t-r-i-b-u-t-e-d n-o-t-i-c-e-s c-o-n-t-a-i-n-i-n-g c-o-e-r-c-i-v-e l-a-n-g-u-a-g-e, l-e-a-v-i-n-g d-a-t-e-d c-o-p-i-e-s o-f t-h-e t-h-r-e-a-t-e-n-i-n-g s-u-b-j-e-c-t-l-i-n-e-s, w-h-i-l-e s-k-i-p-p-i-n-g t-h-e i-n-t-e-n-t i-m-p-r-o-v-e-m-e-n-t v-e-r-i-f-i-c-a-t-i-o-n.
4) t-h-e a-c-t-o-r d-e-l-a-y-e-d n-e-c-e-s-s-a-r-y r-e-p-a-i-r-s t-o d-e-g-r-a-d-e c-o-n-d-i-t-i-o-n-s, l-e-a-v-i-n-g v-i-s-i-b-l-e m-a-i-n-t-e-n-a-n-c-e d-e-f-e-c-t-r-e-c-o-r-d-s, w-h-i-l-e s-k-i-p-p-i-n-g t-h-e h-a-b-i-t-a-b-i-l-i-t-y c-o-d-e a-u-d-i-t.
5) t-h-e a-c-t-o-r d-e-l-i-b-e-r-a-t-e-l-y a-v-o-i-d-e-d o-f-f-i-c-i-a-l v-i-s-i-t-s, l-e-a-v-i-n-g u-n-a-n-s-w-e-r-e-d i-n-s-p-e-c-t-i-o-n r-e-q-u-e-s-t-s a-n-d g-a-p-p-e-d l-o-g e-n-t-r-y-s, w-h-i-l-e s-k-i-p-p-i-n-g t-h-e r-e-g-u-l-a-t-o-r-y c-o-m-p-l-i-a-n-c-e c-h-e-c-k.
